ops.title: Close hermes-docker-proxy symlink TOCTOU in policy.go
ops.description: Deferred from the June security review: pkgs/hermes-docker-proxy/policy.go bind-mount validation can be raced via symlinks (TOCTOU). Resolve symlinks/realpath before policy checks and add a regression test in policy_test.go.

ops.text: policy.go resolves symlinks before validating bind sources and policy_test.go has a TOCTOU regression case; go test ./... passes
